title: Attention-Based Neural Networks for Language Understanding
abstract: This paper explores attention mechanisms for improving contextual understanding in natural language processing tasks.

title: Efficient Transformer Architectures for Large Language Models
abstract: This study investigates architectural modifications that reduce computational requirements while maintaining model performance.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Knowledge Discovery
abstract: This research presents a retrieval-augmented generation framework for extracting relevant information from scientific literature.

title: A Comparative Study of Neural Network Optimization Techniques
abstract: This paper compares multiple optimization algorithms and evaluates their effects on convergence speed and model accuracy.

title: Lightweight Models for Edge-Based Artificial Intelligence
abstract: This study examines model compression techniques for deploying machine learning systems on resource-constrained devices.
